name: Almond Joy & Mounds Bars (Double Coconut & Whole Nut Hazard)
whyItWorks: Combines two of the highest risk food textures in gastroenterology: dense shredded woody coconut meat and whole hard roasted almonds. The coconut fibers intertwine while whole almonds shatter into sharp jagged rocks, creating an acute small bowel blockage risk.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Stricture Warning: Avoid Almond Joy and Mounds bars completely. Choose 3 Musketeers, Milky Way, or Kit Kat for safe chocolate enjoyment.
watchOuts: High risk of small bowel obstruction and severe mucosal irritation from woody coconut fibers and whole nuts.
